a: IMAP lets clients read and manage mail on the server.
POP3 downloads mail to a client, often removing it from the server.
SPF/DKIM/DMARC authenticate senders and reduce spoofing/phishing.
Transactional email is triggered by product events (signup, receipt).
Deliverability depends on reputation, authentication, content, and engagement.
Bounces signal invalid addresses; hard bounces should be suppressed.
MIME structures multipart email (text, HTML, attachments).
Send email asynchronously via a queue so web requests stay fast.
Marketing mail must include a working unsubscribe mechanism where required.
